---
title: "Deliverable and assessment"
subtitle: "Module 5 — capstone"
---

## What to hand in

A **one-page brief** (PDF or doc) containing:

- a key message of two sentences;
- the data and quality section (genomes analysed / excluded, and why);
- **one figure** (tree or timeline) with a self-explanatory caption;
- an interpretation with an explicit confidence level;
- limits and recommendations.

## Presentation

Five minutes per pair, then questions.

## Grid

| Criterion | Points |
|---|---|
| Data quality handled correctly (exclusions justified) | 2 |
| Correct lineages and relationships | 3 |
| Figure clear and honest | 2 |
| Wording matches evidence, limits stated | 2 |
| Useful, concrete recommendations | 1 |
